stem.text: Cyclic esters are also known as lactones. *Delta* lactone is used as a solvent and in the manufacture of polyesters.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of delta lactone: a six-membered ring containing one ring oxygen, with a C=O group on the ring carbon next to that oxygen
stem.label: delta lactone

stem.text: From which compound could *delta* lactone be made by a single reaction?
